works.title: "Black Swan Day" Op-Ed (Malcolm Little King)
works.description: A Malcolm Little King opinion piece predicting Trump's impeachment by May 15, 2026, using detailed political analysis of ideological fractures in right-wing politics. The article combines textual argumentation with custom-generated visual illustrations portraying the scenario, and was published online where it achieved viral traction (100+ views in first hour on Reddit with extended discussion).
works.quote: I am writing a book called American Jesus, and its main purpose is to drive a wedge into this ideological fracture, which is essential to the political right's survival... Malcolm Little King's magnum opus to date... it got more attention in the first hour than the Trump=Loser piece got in 24 hours.

works.title: Editorial Cartoon in Thomas Nast Style (The Broadcaster)
works.description: A political editorial cartoon executed in 1880s Harper's Weekly engraved aesthetic, depicting a news broadcaster with vulgar visual composition as political commentary on media falsehood-spreading. The work involves detailed specifications for visual design elements (cross-hatching, composition, symbolic anatomy) being iteratively refined.
works.quote: Editorial cartoon in the style of Thomas Nast, 1880s Harper's Weekly engraved aesthetic... The figure's head is unmistakably an ass — literally a giant butt with two cheeks forming the head... Slick suit, undone tie, microphone in hand, back-lit by TV camera light.
